# GAOS v1.0.1 — durable speech supersession patch

GAOS v1.0.1 is an additive patch for hands-free voice products. It keeps the
v1.0 API and replay contracts compatible while moving resumed-input assembly
into the durable room-agent runtime.

## Included

- `RoomAgentRunInput.supersession.inputPolicy` selects `replace` or `append`.
- Append mode atomically carries an unfinished predecessor input into its
  correlated replacement and avoids duplicating a complete restatement.
- Optional bounds shorten the predecessor first and retain the latest fragment.
- Exact retries reproduce the same merged input across cancellation/admission
  crash boundaries.
- Waiting-for-input transitions remain authoritative and never inherit the
  previous answer through append mode.
- Post-v1.0 progress, cancellation, checkpoint, output-isolation, and recovery
  corrections are included.

## Migration

Existing v1.0.0 callers require no changes. Update package pins to `v1.0.1`.
Products should opt into append mode only when their interaction state knows a
new final speech fragment continues an active input that has not been consumed.
Omission retains replace behavior.
